questions.stem: A reaction profile shows reactants at 100 kJ, a peak at 180 kJ, and products at 40 kJ. What is the activation energy for the reverse reaction?
questions.explanation: The activation energy for the reverse reaction is measured from the products to the peak: Ea(reverse) = 180 - 40 = 140 kJ. The reverse reaction has a higher activation energy than the forward reaction (180 - 100 = 80 kJ) because this is an exothermic forward reaction.
